title: .npmrc: literal _authToken scoped to a registry
summary: A synthetic .npmrc with a scoped registry line and a //host/:_authToken line holding a literal value that has no recognizable token prefix.
rationale: Detection by token shape fails when the value is an arbitrary string; the setting name and its registry-scope prefix are what identify it. The prefix is syntax: the secret is only the value after the equals sign.

expectation.rationale: Flag the value after _authToken=. The npm documentation lists _authToken as the authentication token setting, requires it to be scoped to a registry by a URI fragment prefix, and says the scoping ensures npm will never send credentials to the wrong host. The registry URL and scope prefix are not given spans.

sources.supports: _authToken (authentication token); the settings _auth, _authToken, username, _password, certfile, and keyfile must all be scoped to a specific registry. This ensures that npm will never send credentials to the wrong host.
